Looking at panel C, the two recorded regions are the hippocampus (Hipp, green) and the amygdala (Amg, yellow). In MNI space the y‑axis runs anterior–posterior, with positive values = anterior. The yellow amygdala cluster sits at more positive y values (≈ 0 to +10 mm) than the green hippocampal cluster (≈ −30 to −10 mm), placing the amygdala more anteriorly. This matches known anatomy, where the amygdala lies at the anterior tip of the temporal lobe, just in front of the hippocampus. The other listed structures (ACC, CC) are not the regions analyzed in this figure.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
